turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend per order; the closest metrics are ad_spend_eur and orders_total (filtered on order status). For 1 to 30 September 2026, Ad spend (EUR) was 6270.0 EUR, and non-cancelled orders were 60 placed and 50 shipped (I do not compute the ratio myself).
